The source generator finds partial classes that carry it, builds an ObjectSerializationInfo for the T in their IMessagePackFormatter<T> through a new GeneratedFormatterCollector, and writes the formatter body into the user's partial class instead of a new internal sealed class. Members of T are picked in contractless mode (public read-write members under string keys) or from a surrogate type's [Key]/[IgnoreMember] annotations. Four new diagnostics (MsgPack019 to MsgPack022) cover misuse, and new tests use a helper assembly that has no MessagePack reference.","why":"MP-2129 asks for a source-generated formatter for a type declared in a referenced library that has no MessagePack attributes or reference.
